output_list.criticism: The amount of tokens to burn is calculated as collateral[msg.sender][address(token)] * amount / collateralCredit[msg.sender][address(token)]. If collateralCredit[msg.sender][address(token)] is very large, this can cause an integer overflow and result in a large burn amount.

The amount of tokens to mint is calculated as LINK.getPriceUSD(address(token)) * amount / uint256(10)**token.decimals(). If amount is very large, this can cause an integer overflow and result in a large mint amount.
The reward rate is calculated as reward / DURATION. If DURATION is very large, this can cause an integer overflow and result in a large reward rate.
The amount of tokens to withdraw is calculated as IERC20(address(this)).balanceOf(msg.sender). If the balance is very large, this can cause an integer overflow and result in a large withdraw amount.
The amount of tokens to deposit is calculated as token.balanceOf(msg.sender). If the balance is very large, this can cause an integer overflow and result in a large deposit amount.
The amount of tokens to transfer is calculated as amount. If amount is very large, this can cause an integer overflow and result in a large transfer amount.
The amount of tokens to transfer is calculated as amount. If amount is very large, this can cause an integer overflow and result in a large transfer amount.
The amount of tokens to approve is calculated as amount. If amount is very large, this can cause an integer overflow and result in a large approval amount.
The amount of tokens to approve is calculated as amount. If amount is very large, this can cause an integer overflow and result in a large approval amount.
The balance of an account is calculated as balances[account]. If the balance is very large, this can cause an integer overflow and result in a large balance.
The allowance of an account is calculated as allowances[account][spender]. If the allowance is very large, this can cause an integer overflow and result in a large allowance.
The amount of tokens to transfer is calculated as reward. If reward is very large, this can cause an integer overflow and result in a large transfer amount.
The amount of tokens to unstake is calculated as stakes[msg.sender]. If stakes[msg.sender] is very large, this can cause an integer overflow and result in a large unstake amount.
The amount of tokens to unstake is calculated as amount. If amount is very large, this can cause an integer overflow and result in a large unstake amount.
The amount of tokens to stake is calculated as amount. If amount is very large, this can cause an integer overflow and result in a large stake amount.
The reward rate is calculated as rewardRate * DURATION. If DURATION is very large, this can cause an integer overflow and result in a large reward rate.

The last time reward is applicable is calculated as Math.min(block.timestamp, periodFinish). If periodFinish is very large, this can cause an integer overflow and result in a large last time reward applicable.

The reward per token is calculated as rewardPerTokenStored + ((lastTimeRewardApplicable() - lastUpdateTime) * rewardRate * 1e18 / stakedSupply). If stakedSupply is very large, this can cause an integer overflow and result in a large reward per token.
The reward of an account is calculated as rewards[account]. If the reward is very large, this can cause an integer overflow and result in a large reward.

The user reward per token paid of an account is calculated as userRewardPerTokenPaid[account]. If the reward is very large, this can cause an integer overflow and result in a large user reward per token paid.
The stake of an account is calculated as stakes[account]. If the stake is very large, this can cause an integer overflow and result in a large stake.
The total supply is calculated as totalSupply. If the total supply is very large, this can cause an integer overflow and result in a large total supply.
The staked supply is calculated as stakedSupply. If the staked supply is very large, this can cause an integer overflow and result in a large staked supply.
The reward rate is calculated as rewardRate. If the reward rate is very large, this can cause an integer overflow and result in a large reward rate.
The period finish is calculated as periodFinish. If periodFinish is very large, this can cause an integer overflow and result in a large period finish.
